title: 18k Yellow Gold Engagement Rings
description:
For those who gravitate toward depth and warmth, 18k yellow gold engagement rings deliver a richer expression of classic elegance. With 75% pure gold, this alloy boasts a deeper hue than its 14k counterpart and offers a softer, more luxurious finish, ideal for those seeking a jewel that feels opulent and personal.

Ecksand's 18k yellow gold engagement rings are handcrafted in our Montreal atelier from recycled gold and set with ethically sourced diamonds. Whether you're drawn to a bold solitaire or a refined pavé band, each piece is made with precision and purpose. While 18k gold is slightly softer than 14k, its higher gold content gives it a luminous glow that sets it apart, a true nod to traditional fine jewelry.

Each diamond is customizable through our ring builder, allowing you to select your preferred cut, carat, and clarity. Choose between natural and lab-grown diamonds, all held to the highest ethical and quality standards.

Made in Canada and certified with the National Hallmark, these rings are crafted through a fully vertical process, from gold sourcing to final polish, under one roof. This approach ensures transparency, excellence, and a jewel that doesn't just reflect your style, but your values. This is gold without shortcuts; refined, radiant, and responsibly made.

title: Anniversary Gifts
description:
Mark every chapter with meaning. Ecksand’s anniversary gifts celebrate milestones of enduring love, whether it’s your first year together or a lifetime later. Each piece is designed and handcrafted in Canada, made from 100% recycled gold and set with ethically sourced diamonds and gemstones that symbolize time, intention, and renewal.

For couples reaffirming their journey, explore our collection of vow renewal rings—pieces that capture the beauty of lasting connection. From delicate vow renewal rings for her to bold and timeless vow renewal rings for him, each design reflects a shared story built on strength and commitment.

Our selection includes elegant rings for vow renewal, crafted with the same care and artistry as our bridal creations. Whether you prefer minimalist bands, diamond-set wedding rings, or modern designs that echo your evolving style, these jewels serve as powerful emblems of devotion reimagined.

Discover wedding renewal rings that merge meaning with craftsmanship, made to be worn every day as reminders of promises kept and love renewed. Because at Ecksand, every jewel tells a story, and every milestone deserves one that lasts.

title: Anniversary Rings
description:
Anniversary rings at Ecksand are crafted reflections of time, growth, and partnership. Whether celebrating your first year or your fiftieth, each piece is handcrafted in our Montreal atelier using recycled gold and ethically sourced stones, including natural diamonds, sapphires, and emeralds.

Designed with longevity in mind, these rings are offered in timeless silhouettes that layer beautifully with your wedding band or engagement ring. Choose from classic eternity bands, minimalist diamond bands, or colourful gemstone rings that speak to the personal milestones you’ve shared.

This selection is curated to meet a range of styles and sentiments; from bold, symbolic pieces to subtle designs that carry intimate meaning. Many choose anniversary rings to mark vow renewals, to refresh a bridal stack, or simply to honour the everyday act of choosing one another.

Ecksand’s anniversary rings are built to be lived in, and passed down. Crafted with purpose, they offer beauty that endures far beyond the moment of giving.

title: Arctic Dragon
description: Explore Ecksand's Arctic Dragon Collection, featuring stunning rings, necklaces, and earrings crafted from recycled gold and ethical diamonds. Inspired by the Arctic’s pristine beauty and the fierce spirit of dragons, this sustainable jewelry line blends serene elegance with bold strength. Perfect for those seeking eco-friendly, statement pieces that celebrate adventure and individuality.

title: Asscher Diamond Engagement Rings
description:
Geometric. Reflective. Unapologetically bold. Ecksand's Asscher engagement rings are a study in precision and presence, designed for those who gravitate toward symmetry, strength, and quiet impact.

First introduced in the early 1900s, the Asscher cut is defined by its cropped corners, step-cut facets, and deep pavilion, creating a hall-of-mirrors effect that draws the eye inward. Unlike brilliant cuts that scatter light, Asscher-cut diamonds reflect it back with clarity and intention, making every flicker feel architectural.

Our collection features a curated selection of Asscher-cut solitaires, three-stone rings, and halo designs, each handcrafted in our Montreal atelier using 100% recycled gold or platinum. Choose from lab-grown or natural diamonds, each one ethically sourced and selected for its symmetry, clarity, and visual depth.

Customizing your Asscher engagement ring is simple with our Diamond Ring Builder. Choose your preferred carat, cut, and clarity to create a diamond ring that feels personal, powerful, and enduring. Pair your center stone with a pavé band for extra brilliance, or opt for a clean setting to let the geometry speak for itself.

As with every Ecksand ring, each Asscher design is made through our fully vertical process — from design to final polish — ensuring sustainable practices and uncompromising quality throughout.

This is elegance with structure. A ring that doesn't follow trends, it holds its ground.

title: Aura® Chrome
description:
The Aura® Chrome Jewelry collection translates the line’s energy into a signature trail of white gold and diamonds. In this confident interpretation, the luster of the precious metal merges with the stones' brilliance to create a seamless, absolute purity.

Here, the high-polish finish amplifies refraction, generating a monochromatic radiance that is both sleek and intense. Faithful to Ecksand’s versatile spirit, each piece plays with reflections, reinventing and offering a visual presence that magnifies your aura and personality with every gesture.

Each design, crafted in recycled 18K white gold, is conceived as a study of form. The absence of color highlights the perfection of the setting, creating a harmony where metal and stone become one. This aesthetic honors the strength of pure lines and the impact of a mastered design. Through Aura® Chrome Jewelry, Erica Bianchini delivers a collection of assertive character: jewelry defined by structure and light, revealing an aura of unmistakable distinction.

title: Aura® Classic
description:
Aura® transforms like energy itself. Shifting, flowing, and igniting what surrounds it. One touch is enough to create an empowering chain reaction, where each detail sparks the next and the atmosphere reshapes in response.

The collection’s design is a study in motion. Flipping curves open new perspectives, transformative in the way new designs reveal themselves. Light dances across diamond pavé rings and brushed gold jewelry, alive in its resonance, spirited in its rhythm; Aura® made real through the integrity of Canadian craftsmanship.

Designed by Creative Director Erica Bianchini and brought to life through Ecksand’s visionary artisans, precision and intuition come together in the Maison’s latest collection to channel jewelry that carries more than form.

title: Aura® Diamond Jewelry
description:
The Aura® Diamond Jewelry collection elevates the line’s primal energy, pushing the sensory experience to its peak, where refraction meets pure radiance. Inspired by Ecksand’s spirit of metamorphosis, these versatile designs evolve with you, featuring intricate pavé settings that sculpt light from every angle. Every creation captures your inner-radiance, translating personal energy into a stream of pure luminescence.

In this interplay of transparency and reflection, Canadian savoir-faire becomes the mirror of your identity. Our jewelry balances radical ethics with exceptional design: natural diamonds, set with millimetric precision, bear witness to an artisanal virtuosity that transforms the setting into a crystalline glow; the signature of authentic, refined excellence.

Through Aura® Diamond Jewelry, Erica Bianchini creates a sanctuary where technical mastery fades before pure emotion. This collection does more than just adorn the skin, it reveals the unique aura of the wearer.

title: Bangles
description:
Sculptural. Seamless. Built to be seen, and kept close. Ecksand’s bangles are a study in form, strength, and quiet brilliance. Designed and handcrafted in Canada using 100% recycled gold and ethically sourced diamonds or gemstones, each piece reflects the Maison’s dedication to conscious luxury and enduring design.

Whether worn solo or layered with intention, each bangle is shaped to move with you. From refined minimalist cuffs to bold diamond bangles, the collection offers modern heirlooms made for daily wear. Clean lines, hidden clasps, and weight you can feel; every detail is considered, nothing overdone.

Choose from polished gold finishes, pavé diamond accents, or designs that pair seamlessly with your existing jewelry. With their rigid, closed form, bangles bring structure to any bracelet stack, anchoring other pieces while adding texture, shine, and meaning.

Each bangle is crafted through Ecksand’s fully vertical process in our atelier, meaning we control every step, from casting the gold to hand-setting each stone. No outsourcing. No waste. Just fine jewelry that speaks softly but holds its ground.

Whether you’re marking a milestone or simply investing in a piece you’ll reach for every day, these bangles are designed to evolve with you. Layer one. Gift one. Pass one on.

This is jewelry that doesn’t just complete a look, it becomes part of your rhythm.

title: Bezel-Set Rings
description:
Ecksand’s bezel-set rings are a masterclass in restraint. Streamlined, protective, and deeply wearable, these rings are designed for those who move through the world with purpose. The bezel setting encircles the stone in precious metal; an intentional choice that offers both security and uninterrupted fluidity.

Handcrafted in our Montreal atelier using 100% recycled gold or platinum, each ring is set with an ethically sourced diamond, lab-grown or natural, and designed to endure. Whether you’re drawn to the modern clarity of a round diamond, the soft geometry of an oval cut, or a gemstone that adds a personal dimension, this collection meets elegance with engineering.

Bezel-set rings aren’t just visually distinct. They’re structurally sound, offering a low-profile setting that resists daily wear and tear. No prongs. No snags. Just a continuous edge of polished metal that holds your stone firmly in place.

These rings layer effortlessly with our gold bands or diamond wedding rings, shifting seamlessly from engagement to everyday. They speak to a design sensibility that values intention over ornament, craftsmanship over trend.

title: Birthday Gifts
description: Make their special day unforgettable with our collection of birthday jewelry gifts. Ecksand's curated selection of ethically crafted, recycled gold or sustainable platinum pieces are the perfect celebration of another year well-lived. From rings twinkling with conflict-free diamonds to necklaces graced with vibrant, natural gemstones, we offer something for everyone - a testament to our dedication to luxurious sustainability that's as unique as they are.

title: Blossom
description: Ecksand’s Blossom collection inhabits a verdant natural world in which flowers trail down the finger and bloom on the ear, and where a diamond pavé necklace weaves its way between the collarbones. Each piece represents the awakening of spring with the natural asymmetric combination of precious gems and diamonds.

title: Blossom Engagement Rings
description:
Blossom Engagement Rings draw inspiration from the poised grace of nature as it unfolds. Imagined in 2020 by Creative Director Erica Bianchini, the collection reflects a pivotal moment in the Maison’s evolution, marked by expanded sustainable innovation within Ecksand’s Montreal atelier. Each design flourishes through refined asymmetry, echoing the balance and tension inherent in organic forms.

Blossom reveals itself through an interlocking cluster engagement ring design, sculpted to illuminate ethical stones with a natural, unforced glow. Crafted in Canada from solid gold of recycled origin or sustainable platinum, each ring is set with ethical natural diamonds, lab-grown diamonds, or vivid gemstone centres selected for their brilliance and traceable provenance. Light flows between the clustered accents, emulating a bloom caught at the moment it opens.

Within Ecksand’s fully vertically integrated Montreal atelier, the design takes shape through controlled bench-led craftsmanship. Cluster points are positioned through 3D-guided modelling and refined by hand to maintain cohesion while preserving the irregularity that defines the Blossom silhouette. Each element is shaped, assembled through advanced soldering techniques, and hand-set with each individual prong in the cluster, then finished with a multi-stage polish.

Every Blossom engagement ring is engineered to support a range of ethical centre stones: round, oval, emerald, radiant, and other expertly cut shapes. Bearing depth, prong proportions, and under-gallery architecture are recalibrated for each stone to integrate seamlessly within the asymmetrical design. You select the colour, carat, and clarity from the Maison's online curation; Ecksand’s artisans engineer the architecture that carries it.

Blossom embodies a level of technical control that cannot be outsourced or approximated. The metal is shaped by jewellers who understand its thresholds: how clusters must align without compromising stability, how asymmetry is made intentional, and how precision endures through decades of wear.

A study in organic form translated into fine jewelry craft, Blossom flourishes through refined asymmetry.

title: Bracelets
description:
Ecksand’s bracelets are where craftsmanship meets quiet impact. Handcrafted in our Montreal atelier and shaped from 100% recycled gold, each piece is designed to move with you — from everyday rituals to defining moments.

Whether you're drawn to the simplicity of a fine gold chain or the precision of pavé-set diamonds, these bracelets are made to be worn — and worn often. With adjustable lengths, secure clasps, and minimalist silhouettes, they offer a refined balance between statement and subtlety.

Choose from diamond tennis bracelets, sculptural cuffs, personalized charms, or gemstone accents. Each design is crafted with ethically sourced diamonds — lab grown or natural — and made to last through generations of wear.

Whether stacked or worn solo, these pieces bring a touch of intention to your wrist. Every detail reflects our commitment to enduring design, full transparency, and Canadian-made quality.

Invest in a bracelet that anchors your everyday; with meaning, purpose, and just the right amount of brilliance.

title: Bridal Earrings
description:
For a moment this meaningful, only the essentials remain. Ecksand's bridal earrings are designed to frame the face and complete the feeling, timeless silhouettes handcrafted in Canada from 100% recycled gold and ethically sourced diamonds or pearls.

Whether you're walking down the aisle, dancing into the night, or saying yes in the quiet of a morning, this collection offers refined options for every kind of bride. From luminous pearl studs and delicate drops to diamond accents that catch the light just right, each pair is made to complement your day.

These are bridal earrings that hold space for emotion. Lightweight enough for all-day wear, yet crafted with intention and permanence. Their elegance is never overdone, just enough brilliance, just enough presence, and always enough meaning.

Pair a minimalist stud with a low bun and veil, or choose a soft dangle earring to mirror a flowing silhouette. Whether your look is classic, romantic, modern, or somewhere in between, Ecksand's earrings are designed to feel like they were made just for you.

Handmade in our Montreal atelier, each pair is part of our fully vertical process, ensuring sustainability, quality, and ethical sourcing at every step. You'll keep wearing them long after the vows, not because you have to, but because you'll want to.

title: Cardinal
description: The maison's Cardinal Collection is a tribute to the confident beauty of femininity and the diverse paths we tread in life. Celebrating the undeniable allure of our inner compass, this collection features geometric pieces with brilliant diamonds contrasting with artful blackened enamelling to exemplify the enchanting interplay between our paths and choices.

title: Chain Bracelets
description: Our chain bracelets offer sustainably stunning simplicity. A thin chain held by a strong clasp form a beautifully elegant piece for a lifetime of wear.

title: Cluster Engagement Rings
description:
There's beauty in togetherness - and Ecksand's cluster engagement rings embody just that. Like all of our diamond engagement rings, cluster rings are designed in our Montreal atelier using sustainable materials and ethically sourced diamonds. Each cluster engagement ring brings multiple stones together in a luminous composition that's both delicate and dynamic.

More than a design choice, the diamond or gemstone cluster ring symbolizes unity and depth. Whether perfectly symmetrical or charmingly off-center, our asymmetrical engagement rings highlight Ecksand's dedication to fluidity, proportion, and innovative form. Inspired by constellations and crafted with care, these rings channel the energy of stars grouped in the night sky - luminous, interconnected, and radiant.

From minimal cluster ring designs to more elaborate settings, each piece is handcrafted in recycled gold or platinum, with an eye for longevity and everyday wearability. For those who seek character over convention, a cluster diamond engagement ring offers charm, sparkle, and symbolism - all in one.

This collection celebrates the harmony of many, the brilliance of difference, and the joy of stories told together. Discover cluster engagement rings that speak softly, shine boldly, and reflect a love that's anything but ordinary.

title: Cocktail Rings
description:
Unapologetically bold and deeply intentional, Ecksand’s cocktail rings are made to stand at the intersection of artistry and ethical design. Far from fleeting trends, these statement pieces are handcrafted in our Montreal atelier using 100% recycled gold and responsibly sourced gemstones, offering a refined take on maximalism.

Each cocktail ring plays with scale, colour, and texture; designed to hold space on the hand without ever feeling heavy. From rich sapphires to angular rose-cuts and asymmetric compositions, the rings showcase the versatility of gemstone rings when executed with precision.

Worn solo or styled with simple bands, these rings are made to shift the centre of gravity in your jewelry wardrobe. They’re celebratory, yes; but also structural, wearable, and rooted in longevity. Whether you’re marking a milestone or dressing for impact, a cocktail ring from Ecksand becomes a permanent fixture, not just a statement.

For those who value design that speaks with presence, this is gemstone jewelry that doesn’t ask for attention; it claims it.

title: Conch Earrings
description:
Ecksand introduces a groundbreaking approach to conch earrings, blending timeless elegance with modern innovation. After over two years of dedicated development, our team has perfected a design that adorns the ear seamlessly, no piercing required.

This feat of engineering features a discreet gold bar that gracefully ascends the back of the ear, ensuring a secure fit that remains comfortably in place. The conch element elegantly wraps around the ear's curvature, offering a sophisticated aesthetic without compromising on comfort.

Embracing versatility, these earrings are compatible with various conch studs, empowering you to mix and match to reflect your unique style. Crafted from 100% recycled gold with zero porosity, each piece embodies Ecksand's unwavering commitment to sustainable luxury and impeccable craftsmanship.

title: Curved Wedding Rings
description: Elevate your ring stack with Ecksand’s Curved Wedding Rings, where precise design aligns seamlessly with existing bands. Each piece is ethically handcrafted using responsibly sourced materials, showcasing the harmony of meticulous artistry and modern aesthetics.

title: Cushion Diamond Engagement Rings
description:
Soft edges. Deep sparkle. Enduring impact. Ecksand's cushion diamond engagement rings bring together antique charm and modern craftsmanship, a square or rectangular silhouette softened by rounded corners, designed to catch light and keep it close.

Known for their pillow-like shape and brilliant faceting, cushion cut diamonds offer a balance between fire and clarity, making them a favorite among those who seek subtle drama and timeless design. Whether set as a classic solitaire, a three-stone ring, or framed in a halo, these diamonds create a sense of quiet elegance with a bold undercurrent.

Each diamond ring in this collection is handcrafted in our Montreal workshop using 100% recycled gold or platinum and set with ethical diamonds, natural or lab-grown. Ecksand's fully vertical production model ensures quality and sustainability at every step, from the gold we use to the way we set each stone by hand.

Customize your cushion engagement ring through our Diamond Ring Builder. Choose your carat, clarity, and cut, then pair your cushion diamond with a setting that feels uniquely yours, refined, intentional, and built to last.

Loved for over a century, the cushion cut has never felt more relevant. In Ecksand's hands, it becomes a ring that blends softness with structure, legacy with modern values.

These are rings made not to follow trends, but to quietly outlast them.

title: Dangle Earrings
description:
Add movement, artistry, and expression to your jewelry rotation with Ecksand’s dangle earrings collection. Designed and hallmarked in Canada, each pair blends timeless silhouettes with sculptural detailing for a striking yet wearable statement.

Whether it’s the subtle sway of minimalist gold hanging earrings or the dynamic sparkle of diamond dangles, these earrings are a versatile accessory made to stand out. Explore designs crafted from 100% recycled gold and set with ethically sourced diamonds, sapphires, emeralds, and other vibrant gemstones. From day-to-night essentials to event-ready pieces, these earrings are more than just adornment—they’re enduring expressions of sustainable craftsmanship.

Ecksand’s dangle earrings are made with comfort and elegance in mind. Lightweight yet impactful, they’re designed for effortless wear that doesn’t compromise on sophistication. Each piece is handcrafted in our Montreal atelier, combining precision techniques with a deep respect for sustainable practices.

Whether you're curating your jewelry wardrobe or gifting a meaningful piece, dangle earrings offer an elevated finishing touch. Style them solo or pair them with statement rings, bracelets, or a matching pendant for a cohesive, polished look.

title: Diamond Earrings
description:
Ecksand's diamond earrings are a study in contrasts, raw brilliance refined by intention. Handcrafted in our Montreal atelier from 100% recycled gold and set with ethically sourced diamonds, each pair represents a commitment to elevated essentials that never compromise on sustainability or craftsmanship.

This collection spans sculptural studs, modern hoops, and sweeping drop earrings - all rooted in minimalist forms that command attention through quality, not volume. These are ethical diamond earrings that carry weight in meaning, not flash. Designed for the wearer who values eco-consciousness, they offer enduring style that adapts seamlessly from day to night, from statement moments to quiet confidence.

The artistry lies in the restraint. Each pair of handcrafted diamond earrings is modeled for balance and comfort, marrying timeless proportions with bold, considered details. Whether you're curating your daily uniform or marking a milestone, these recycled gold earrings bring elegance without excess.

Ecksand's diamond earrings aren't made to follow trends - they're made to last through them. Discover sustainable fine jewelry that redefines what it means to shine.

title: Diamond Engagement Rings
description:
A diamond may be forever, but how it's sourced, crafted, and worn matters just as much. Ecksand's diamond engagement rings are designed with care, intention, and full transparency, from sourcing to setting. Crafted in Canada using 100% recycled gold or platinum and set with ethical natural or lab-grown diamonds, each diamond ring reflects the values that endure alongside the commitment it represents.

From timeless solitaires to pavé bands, brilliant halos, and three-stone silhouettes, this collection offers a curated range of styles designed to evolve with you. Each engagement ring is handcrafted in our Montreal atelier through a fully vertical production process; no middlemen, no shortcuts, just craftsmanship shaped by purpose.

Choose your diamond through our Diamond Ring Builder, selecting your preferred carat, clarity, cut, and origin. Whether you gravitate toward the bold geometry of emerald or radiant cuts, the fire of a round brilliant, or the softness of oval or cushion shapes, every Ecksand diamond is chosen to meet the highest standards, in quality and in ethics.

What sets our diamond engagement rings apart is the story they carry. From the recycled metals that form the setting to the master jewelers behind every piece, each ring is a quiet act of intention.

This is where timeless meets traceable. Sustainability meets emotion. And luxury meets legacy.

title: Diamond Jewelry
description:
Crafted with intention and rooted in sustainability, Ecksand’s diamond jewelry collection is a celebration of craftsmanship, purity, and quiet brilliance. Designed and handcrafted in Canada, each piece is made using 100% recycled gold and ethically sourced diamonds.

From timeless diamond earrings to sculptural diamond rings and meaningful diamond pendants, the collection invites you to explore refined silhouettes made with thoughtful detail. Whether you gravitate toward a minimalist diamond band or a bold statement earring, every design offers a modern perspective on enduring style.

At the heart of each jewel lies a diamond chosen not just for its sparkle, but for its story. Ecksand offers both lab grown and natural diamonds, each selected with care to ensure traceability, quality, and long-term wear. These jewels are wearable heirlooms, shaped by our commitment to transparency, slow design, and Canadian artistry.

Explore diamond jewelry that transcends occasion. Elegant enough for life’s biggest milestones, refined enough for everyday wear, and conscious in every facet. These are pieces that hold meaning, designed to move with you through every chapter.

title: Diamond Necklaces
description:
Imagine a striking silhouette that never goes out of style. The diamond necklace is the epitome of refined elegance. At Ecksand, we take pride in crafting each diamond necklace by hand in our Montreal workshop, using 100% recycled gold and featuring either conflict-free natural or lab-grown diamonds. The result? A stunning piece that gracefully hugs your neckline, merging timeless design with a modern commitment to sustainability.

These necklaces are more than just beautiful accessories. With their smooth lines and perfect fit, they make a bold visual statement, striking a perfect balance between strength and softness, luxury and responsibility. Whether you choose to wear a simple diamond necklace alone for a dramatic effect, or layer it with delicate pendants for added depth, our diamond collar necklaces and diamond pendants are designed to ground your everyday look and elevate your evening attire. Our dedication to ethical craftsmanship means that each diamond necklace in this collection is infused with more than just brilliance, it embodies a purpose.

title: Diamond Rings

Ecksand’s diamond rings are available in a range of settings, from solitaire and pavé to three-stone and eternity bands. With meticulous attention to detail, each piece highlights the natural brilliance and clarity of the diamond it holds, offering quiet impact and effortless versatility.

Perfect as engagement rings, wedding bands, or stackable rings, these designs are made for lifetime wear. Style them on their own or layer them with gold bands, gemstone rings, or diamond bands for a curated look that blends tradition with individual expression.

With a focus on sustainability and ethical sourcing, this collection brings together beauty, purpose, and expert Canadian craftsmanship.

Discover real diamond jewelry made in Canada.

title: Diamond Stud Earrings
description:
Diamond studs are an essential. You reach for them instinctively, not because they demand attention, but because they elevate your presence every day. The Ecksand Diamond Stud Collection brings this idea into sharp focus: refined silhouettes shaped to highlight ethical lab and natural diamonds through Canadian craft.

Handcrafted within our fully vertical Montreal atelier with solid gold of recycled origin or sustainable platinum, each pair comes to life through disciplined craft. The Maison's expert gemmologists carefully consider each diamond’s cut, clarity, and colour for optimal proportion and long-lasting brilliance. Settings are engineered for comfort and optimal light interaction. These studs aren’t about excess, they’re about capturing your presence.

Discover classic round-cut studs, modern Asscher-cut designs, milgrain-set ovals, cushions, and more: each crafted to enhance a diamond’s natural luminosity. Whether you’re drawn to traditional brilliance or a contemporary diamond shape, these earrings elevate any look.

Diamond studs are also meaningful gifts. They’re ideal for celebrating birthdays, graduations, anniversaries, promotions, or simply the gift of an everyday signature. For milestone gifting inspiration, explore complementary collections like diamond jewelry, graduation gifts, or anniversary gifts.

Pair your studs with understated pieces from our gold necklaces or create a bold ear stack with designs from hoop earrings, crawler earrings, or bridal earrings. For gemstone lovers, our gemstone earrings offer playful alternatives that blend beautifully with diamond studs.

These are diamond stud earrings designed to capture your presence while embodying the Maison's approach to gentle luxury.

title: Diamond Tennis Bracelets
description:
Timeless by design, modern in purpose, Ecksand’s diamond tennis bracelets are a tribute to enduring elegance. Inspired by the clean lines and iconic silhouettes of mid-20th century jewelry, these bracelets feature a continuous row of ethically sourced diamonds, each handset in our Montreal atelier using recycled gold.

Whether worn alone or layered, these bracelets embody quiet sophistication and are built for daily wear thanks to their secure clasp and expertly balanced weight.

Elevate the everyday with a gold tennis bracelet that marries heritage with ethics, and redefine what it means to wear brilliance with intention.

title: Diamond Wedding Rings
description: Experience refined craftsmanship with Ecksand’s Diamond Wedding Rings, ethically handcrafted to showcase pristine brilliance and thoughtful aesthetics. Each ring merges responsibly sourced diamonds with impeccable savoir-faire, ensuring a standout piece with enduring value.

title: Duel®
description: Inspired by fencing, the iconic Ecksand Duel® fine jewelry collection is about facing and overcoming challenges. This signature collection boasts powerful jewelry with sharp edges, clean lines, and an air of self-confidence, where less is more as long as it’s big, bold, and fearless.

title: Ear Climber Earrings
description:
Crawler earrings, also known as ear climber earrings or ear crawlers, bring dimension to your jewelry rotation, adding length and movement without the need for multiple piercings. From minimalist gold ear climbers to diamond-studded climber earrings that catch the light with every turn, this collection redefines directional jewelry. Each piece is made with ergonomic comfort in mind, sculpted to sit securely and comfortably against the ear. Whether you’re seeking ear crawler earrings for a statement look or looking to layer with classic studs and hoops, these designs invite play and personal expression.

Explore crawler earrings in Canada that combine craftsmanship, comfort, and contemporary design. Worn solo or stacked with intention, they’re the kind of earrings that don’t follow trends; they climb past them.

title: Earrings
description:
There's nothing like a piece of jewelry that stands the test of time. At Ecksand, our collection of sustainable earrings is handcrafted in our Montreal atelier using recycled gold, sustainable platinum, and ethically sourced diamonds and gemstones; designed for lifetime wear, with sustainability at its core.

From subtle elegance to bold statements, each style is crafted to suit every expression. Our diamond earrings elevate everyday looks with unmatched brilliance, while stud earrings offer a timeless foundation for any jewelry wardrobe, perfect for stacking or wearing solo. Explore the full collection to find earrings that feel as good as they look; consciously crafted, endlessly versatile, and distinctly Ecksand.

title: Emerald Engagement Rings
description:
A symbol of renewal, wisdom, and enduring love, emeralds bring a distinct voice to the traditional engagement ring. title: Pavé Setting Engagement Rings
description:
The pavé setting isn’t about a single diamond, it’s about the power of many. French for "paved," pavé rings are designed with rows of closely set diamonds along the band, creating the illusion of continuous sparkle. Used to line the band, this technique adds refined brilliance to any engagement ring without overwhelming the design.

At Ecksand, every pavé engagement ring is handcrafted in our Montreal workshop using recycled gold or platinum and ethically sourced diamonds. From delicate micro-pavé to bold, full diamond pavé bands, each style is engineered for daily wear with exceptional attention to detail.

Our pavé diamond settings pair beautifully with round, oval, radiant, and cushion-cut center stones, and the diamond itself can be personalized through our diamond ring builder. Whether lab-grown or natural, each stone is carefully selected for clarity, light return, and ethical sourcing.

Thanks to our fully vertical process, we control every stage of production, from casting the recycled metal to hand-setting each micro diamond. The result: seamless brilliance, made responsibly.

For those who value subtle luxury, these pavé setting diamond engagement rings offer texture, shimmer, and a sense of quiet precision. It’s a setting that speaks in detail, soft-spoken yet brilliant, intentional yet versatile.

Whether you’re marking milestones or curating your everyday look, these rings balances refined craftsmanship with expressive design. 

Explore subtle bands, textured silhouettes, and vibrant pops of color, including our most-loved sapphire stacking ring, shimmering stackable diamond rings, like this stunning milgrain diamond ring, and even stackable engagement rings or diamond stacked wedding rings. Every stone is selected for its beauty, origin, and durability, set securely in rings that resist tarnish and endure daily wear.

Whether worn in matching metals or mixed finishes, these conflict-free diamond and gemstone rings offer endless combinations without compromise. Build a stack that evolves with you, elegant, personal, and consciously crafted. Perfect for those looking for stackable rings in Canada made with real materials and lasting meaning.

title: Stacking Bracelets
description:
Build your signature stack, one bracelet at a time. Ecksand’s stacking bracelets collection invites you to layer with purpose; from sleek minimalist cuffs to shimmering bracelets that elevate your everyday.

Each piece is handcrafted in our Montreal atelier using 100% recycled gold and ethically sourced stones. Whether you’re starting your stackable bracelet collection or curating a full bracelet stack, these designs offer balance, harmony, and endless possibilities. Wear them solo for a subtle statement or create a stacked bracelet look that’s uniquely yours.

Explore timeless tennis bracelets, gold bracelets, and colorful gemstone bracelets, all designed to layer seamlessly. For a modern approach, try pairing a tennis bracelet stack with bold textures and delicate chain bracelets. If you're looking for fresh bracelet stacking ideas, consider mixing slim cuffs, pavé details, and sculptural silhouettes for depth and contrast.

Ecksand’s layering bracelets are made for movement and built to last, with secure settings and tarnish-resistant finishes that stand up to everyday wear. As always, sustainability and craftsmanship go hand in hand: each piece is made in Canada with longevity in mind.

Looking for stackable bracelets in Canada that blend ethical values with iconic design? These stacking bracelets offer an intentional way to express your style; one layer at a time. For those seeking a more curated approach to stacking bracelets, consider building your look around contrast; pairing structured cuffs with fluid chains, or a diamond tennis bracelet with understated gold bands. This balance of texture and proportion creates a refined foundation for any stackable bracelet arrangement. Thoughtful combinations allow each piece to maintain its presence while contributing to a harmonious whole, offering endless bracelet stacking ideas that evolve with your style.

title: Starlight Diamond Jewelry
description: Inspired by the stillness of the night sky, the Starlight Diamond Jewelry Collection explores light, balance, and gentle radiance through delicate, enduring jewelry designs.

title: Statement Earrings
description: With recycled gold and conflict-free diamonds coming together to create stunningly beautiful jewelry, our statement earrings are sure to make every head turn.

title: Statement Rings
description:
Ecksand’s Statement Rings collection brings together bold silhouettes, sculptural textures, and luminous gemstones designed to amplify your presence with every gesture. Each piece is shaped within our Montreal atelier with solid gold of recycled origin or sustainable platinum through Canadian artistry.

From sleek signets to artful cocktail rings, these statement rings sit at the crossroads of form and emotion. Explore vibrant gemstone styles like the deep, hypnotic ruby cocktail ring, the lush blue sapphire cocktail ring, and the vibrant aventurine cocktail ring from the Mosaic collection. For those drawn to texture, sculpted gold designs such as the dragon-scale gold bombe ring or the gold dragon wrap ring with diamond pavé can bring a refined edge to your look.

Each ring in this collection is crafted to hold its own while pairing seamlessly with the pieces you already love, for example by styling an Ecksand diamond ring with a classic gold stackable ring. Ecksand rings are designed to reflect your unique story unapologetically.

Statement rings also mark the moments worth remembering. Promotions, anniversaries, or achievements that deserve something meaningful. These designs make for alternatives to traditional engagement rings, or as celebratory gifts from our anniversary gifts and graduation gifts collections. Whatever the occasion, the focus remains the same expressive craftsmanship made for your everyday.

Responsibility is built into every Ecksand piece, from recycled metals to traceable stones, ensuring your statement ring feels as thoughtful as it looks. These are designs that don’t follow trends. They shape your presence, accompany your style, and evolve with you.

title: Stud Earrings
description:
Discover timeless minimalism with Ecksand’s stud earrings collection, a curation of versatile essentials made to move with you. Whether you’re dressing for the everyday or curating a layered ear look, these earring studs offer refined brilliance without excess.

Each pair of stud earrings is designed and handcrafted in Canada at our Montreal atelier, using 100% recycled gold and set with ethically sourced diamonds and gemstones. Lightweight and comfortable, Ecksand’s ear studs are sculpted with precision and purpose, blending sleek silhouettes with enduring craftsmanship.

From classic round stud earrings to nature-inspired motifs and bold geometric shapes, this collection captures the quiet impact of intentional design. Whether you’re seeking a single stud earring to mix and match, or a pair of everyday earring studs that add just the right touch of shimmer, these pieces elevate your jewelry box with subtlety and strength. Those exploring a more curated ear stack will appreciate how stud earrings anchor the look with clarity, offering balance alongside hoops, cuffs, or crawler styles.

Looking for something that shines on its own but layers beautifully? Our earring studs are made to be worn solo or stacked across multiple piercings. Pair them with hoop earrings or crawler earrings for a modern, curated ear stack that speaks to your unique style.

As always, our commitment to sustainability is handcrafted into every design. These jewelry staples aren’t just beautiful, they’re consciously crafted to last, with secure settings and tarnish-resistant finishes that stand up to daily wear. Each pair of stud earrings is a small, intentional investment: quietly expressive, effortlessly versatile, and designed for longevity.

Explore earrings that are anything but basic. A quiet staple, a bold expression, and a sustainable investment all at once.

title: The Mark
description: Discover the essence of self-expression with Ecksand's "The Mark" collection. A captivating range that embodies the spirit of treasure hunting. Each piece symbolizes "X marks the spot," encouraging you to chart your own course and cherish others’. Adorn yourself with emblems of discovery and acceptance, where every jewel is a treasure map to your inner riches.

title: Three Stone Engagement Rings
description:
A three stone engagement ring or a trilogy ring is more than a design; it's a timeline. One stone for the past, one for the present, and one for the future. At Ecksand, our trilogy diamond rings offer an elegant way to symbolize the entirety of your journey together through handcrafted artistry and enduring materials.

Each three stone ring is meticulously made in Montreal from recycled gold or sustainable platinum, embodying our commitment to ethical and environmentally conscious jewelry. Whether you prefer 3 diamond engagement rings for their brilliant symmetry or a trio of mixed gemstones for symbolic color, each design brings emotional weight and refined beauty.

Explore vintage three stone engagement ring gold styles alongside modern 3 stone diamond rings, all sculpted with Ecksand's signature balance and attention to detail. These engagement rings are not only symbolic but structurally significant, crafted to stand the test of time with comfort and style.

From intricate cluster and halo settings to clean, contemporary silhouettes, a three stone engagement ring offers layered meaning without sacrificing minimalist elegance. Discover the beauty of your whole story, captured in one unforgettable trilogy ring, made in Canada.

title: Tresses
description: Monochrome and two-toned, the Ecksand Tresses collection revisits the art of twisted gold with a modern eye. Open motifs and minimalist diamond pavés draw one’s eye to the beauty and power-detailed simplicity.

title: Two-Stone Engagement Rings
description:
Symbolizing two souls, one journey, the two stone ring is a timeless emblem of unity and balance. Each Ecksand creation brings together complementary diamonds or gemstones, forming a striking visual harmony that mirrors your partnership’s story.

Handcrafted in our Montreal atelier using recycled gold or platinum, every double diamond ring and double gem ring reflects ethical artistry and refined craftsmanship. Whether you’re drawn to a 2 diamond engagement ring with classic symmetry or a double diamond engagement ring with asymmetrical intrigue, each design captures a blend of modern sophistication and romantic tradition.

This collection celebrates individuality through duality, from minimalist 2 diamond rings to bold, sculptural two gem rings that reinterpret what an engagement ring can be. Personalize your piece with meaningful stone pairings, such as birthstones or a fusion of diamond and colour, for a design that’s deeply personal yet effortlessly elegant.

Perfect for those seeking something distinctive and symbolic, Ecksand’s 2 stone engagement rings are crafted to endure. Visually compelling, structurally sound, and emotionally resonant. Explore a gold two diamond engagement ring that embodies both clarity and connection, designed to be worn for a lifetime.

title: Under $1500
description: Discover our most coveted collection of ethical Fine Jewelry. From timeless gold and pearl pieces to conflict-free diamonds, and natural gemstones - all for under $1500.

title: Valentines Day Gifts
description:
Ecksand’s Valentine’s Day Gifts curation honours love in all its forms, whether celebrating romantic love, self-love, friendship, or family. Discover rings, necklaces, earrings, and bracelets handcrafted in Montreal from solid gold of recycled origin and ethical stones, selected to feel personal, expressive, and unmistakably deliberate for her and for him.

At the heart of the Maison’s design language are signatures shaped by meaning. The Secret Heart® collection reimagines the heart as something intimate and unseen, carved beneath the surface of each diamond ring and known only to the wearer. The XO Collection, inspired by handwritten love letters, translates affection into diamond jewelry that feels personal yet refined. For those drawn to self-expression and transformation, Aura captures the idea that energy shifts and evolves, offering reversible jewelry that shifts with its wearer and reflects inner strength. Revered Starlight designs complete the curation with classic diamond jewelry shaped with modern restraint, crafted to feel effortless and wearable.

Love, served with intention.
Jewels, chosen with confidence.
Moments, shaped the Ecksand way.

Gentle luxury with a signature, unexpected presence, even on Valentine’s Day.

title: Vintage Engagement Rings
description:
Timeless isn’t just a look, it’s a feeling. Ecksand’s vintage engagement rings capture the character of antique design with the integrity of modern craftsmanship. From milgrain details to art deco-inspired halos and delicate filigree bands, each ring is rooted in historical influence and handcrafted with intention.

While the designs may nod to the past, the process is distinctly contemporary. Every vintage-inspired ring is made in our Montreal workshop using recycled gold or platinum and conflict-free diamonds. The result: old-world elegance, built sustainably and transparently.

Our vintage rings are offered with both natural and lab-grown diamonds, each customizable through Ecksand’s diamond ring builder. Whether you’re drawn to a radiant diamond, a timeless cushion, or a classic round brilliant, our builder lets you filter by carat, clarity, and cut, without the overwhelm.

These aren’t replicas. They’re reinterpretations. Vintage design elevated through Ecksand’s fully vertical process and ethical sourcing. From sourcing to setting, we manage every step in-house, ensuring quality you can feel and a story you can stand behind.

If you’re searching for a ring that feels storied but distinctly your own, Ecksand’s vintage engagement rings offer a connection to the past, and a promise to the future.

title: Wedding Gifts
description: Jewelry that speaks the language of love, discover the boundless allure of natural gemstones, ethically sourced diamonds, and signature pearl pieces. Gift our coveted collection of meaningful fine jewelry as a daily reminder of the many facets and colors of courage and devotion.

title: Wedding Rings
description:
Step into a world where tradition meets intention with Ecksand’s gold bands and diamond wedding rings, handcrafted to embody timeless bonds and lasting commitment. Whether you're choosing a marriage ring that speaks to your shared values or a wedding band and engagement ring pairing that tells your love story, Ecksand offers designs that go beyond the expected.

Our collection includes everything from sleek, unadorned wedding bands to intricate, ethically crafted modern wedding rings with diamonds. Every wedding band is made in Montreal from recycled gold or sustainable platinum, shaped in wax molds to achieve Ecksand’s signature fluidity and balance. The result: a wedding ring for couples that feels as good as it looks; in form, fit, and philosophy.

From 18k gold wedding bands with diamonds to platinum wedding rings with sculptural detail, our rings suit every style and love story. Whether you're searching for a wedding ring or planning your engagement ring with wedding band combination, explore the quiet power of ethical wedding bands designed to last a lifetime.

title: Wild
description: The Ecksand Wild collection was born from a deep appreciation for nature's delicate and beautiful creature: the butterfly. Long admired by our artisans for its beauty, strength, and resilience, each piece evokes feelings of renewal and freedom with every gaze.

title: Women's Wedding Rings
description: Delicately feminine with a vintage-inspired aura or bold with a modern twist, only the finest gemstones and diamonds are selected for Ecksand’s Wedding Rings, designed using wax models to ensure Ecksand’s signature fluidity and balance. From diamond semi-eternity wedding bands to vibrant gemstone rings, our wedding bands are meticulously handcrafted by our expert jewellers in our green atelier.

title: Wonder Pearl Jewelry
description:
An invitation to see pearls anew. Ecksand’s Wonder collection reimagines our first-ever jewels, crafted in our Montreal Maison using luminous, ethically sourced Akoya pearls and sculpted recycled gold. These pieces draw from nature’s raw elegance and our commitment to enduring craftsmanship.

Co-founder Yoan Gehant-Vidoni’s roots in the pearl industry and Creative Director Erica Bianchini’s refined design language converge where tradition meets thoughtful evolution. Each pearl is left untouched; no coatings, no treatments, allowing its natural lustre and form to take centre stage.

The collection echoes the ocean’s rhythm: sculptural pearl rings that feel elemental yet elevated; understated earrings that play with light; modern pearl necklaces that rest with quiet confidence. Designed to layer or stand alone, Wonder invites stillness, not spectacle. 

As with all Ecksand creations, the Wonder collection is a testament to ethical craftsmanship; using conflict-free materials, sustainable practices, and proudly bearing the Canadian National Hallmark as a true product of Canada.

title: XO
description: Born from a rapidly moving era, where a binary code of love, the X and O, can break misconstrued fast-paced messages, the exquisite artistry of the XO collection embraces a discreet token of love and candor.
